prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='catboost', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ARIMA and catboost tie for trend champion (corr=1.0), while catboost leads seasonality (corr=0.2031). DWT_rf wins overall RMSE (71.75) despite poor trend alignment (-1.0), suggesting it captures residual patterns well. High model disagreement (rmse_spread=25.1) and split champions warrant STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while handling concept drift.
